description: Returns how credits are counted (1 credit = 1 valid response, charged once per project) and, with 'responses', how many credits an analysis of that many responses costs. Depending on the client it may also list the available credit packages. Use it for cost questions like 'how many credits does it take to analyse 3000 answers'. No account needed. Does not check the user's balance; use open_end_estimate_analysis for an existing project.
name: open_end_get_pricing
title: Get Open-End pricing
